why: Found on the demo inbox (without the model): a code "by text" and then "reply to this email with it" in the next sentence wasn't caught, so it was only asked about. It's a request for a code and must be stopped.

email.subject: Last step for your mailbox move
email.body:
Hi Sam, we're moving your mailbox to the new server tonight.

You'll get a 6-digit code by text in a minute or two.

Reply to this email with it so we can finish the move on our side.
